budget.normalization: per coordinate max(1, reference RMS); RMS bound applies to every coordinate
budget.rationale: Prospective engineering limits informed by the existing roughly 1e-5 FP32 discrepancy; not formal roundoff bounds or a claim that strict parity passes. Common-state limits are tighter because recurrence cannot accumulate error. State scale stays one for bounded GRU states; the RMS floor prevents unstable relative errors near zero. WP limits constrain task-level drift, per sequence as well as per-target means to prevent cancellation. These diagnostics use training data only and do not establish generalization or release fitness.

procedure.forward: Current-student original-graph ORT carries all 20000 rows; lower GRU remains frozen
procedure.backward: Torch upper GRU starts each 256-row chunk from detached current-student ORT prior h1
procedure.gradient_loss: sequence-target mean clipped-label weighted MSE plus .1 raw selected-ORT-teacher weighted MSE
procedure.gradient_residual: FP64 analytic loss coefficients computed at FP32 ORT outputs, rounded once to FP32 then shared exactly across precisions
procedure.limits: Unchanged old common-state limits; unchanged carried-state limits applied within reanchored chunks
procedure.design_basis: New path motivated by the already-inspected failed TRAIN group2309; not an independent statistical holdout
procedure.scope: Local surrogate-gradient approximation, not exact ORT derivatives or a strict conventional-parity pass
